title: %indexOf - first index of a value
purpose: Return the position of a value in an array, or -1 if absent.
notes: Indices are zero-based; a missing value yields ##-1.
The array is given as a JSON-array string so its elements compare as plain values.

avoid.why: a typed ODIN array block wraps each element, so equality never matches and %indexOf always returns ##-1; supply the array as a JSON-array string literal instead
